speaker: narrator
text: Lena let the footage run. The roof vents opening. The spider rising. The jump, so fast that half the room gasped after it had already happened. The boom of the landing, small and tinny through the hall speakers. Then a long, steady shot from the inside camera, looking up at the roof: a man standing perfectly still on a catwalk, and a spider the size of a car crouched on the glass a meter from his face, looking at him.
